verdict.rationale: Lindy runs workflow-like routines on schedules or triggers, so throttling and queueing executions is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions rate limiting, concurrency caps, queueing, or backoff for executions. Schedules and triggers are an adjacent feature and do not count as throttling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can throttle or queue workflow executions to respect downstream rate limits
